definitions: With little or no sound; free of disturbing noise.
Having little motion or activity; calm.
To cause (someone or something) to become quiet.
Hell; the bottomless pit; primeval chaos; a confined subterranean ocean. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}
A bottomless or unfathomed depth, gulf, or chasm; hence, any deep, immeasurable; any void space.

blocks.text: Abyss is the fourth studio album by American singer-songwriter and her eponymous band Chelsea Wolfe. The album was released on August 7, 2015 through Sargent House and was produced by John Congleton. It also features guest contributions from Mike Sullivan of Russian Circles and Dan Phillips from True Widow.
